query: WITH entities AS (SELECT journal_id, created_at, id FROM cala_calculations WHERE journal_id = ANY($1) ORDER BY journal_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $2 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN cala_calculation_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.journal_id, i.created_at desc, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
